text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The morning of White Day. I gave Mihono 
Bourbon some marshmallows in return.
choice_data_list:
Bourbon! That's my return gift for 
Valentine's Day!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding dong dang dong)
choice_data_list: Umm... well then, see you this afternoon!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although Mihono Bourbon accepted the 
marshmallows, she seemed a little off. Did 
something happen?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, y'know, I saw this person 
buying marshmallows as a White Day gift.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, could it be a subtle hint that they 
dislike you? There are different theories, 
but people usually avoid giving 
marshmallows in return to someone they're 
close with~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So that's why Mihono Bourbon reacted like 
that...! I must have disappointed her. I 
have to find a way to express my gratitude 
properly!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Huh? An amusement park?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After training, I told Mihono Bourbon that 
I had another return favor for her, and 
invited her to an amusement park.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ......In that case, I will go get changed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"An amusement park at night... Status: 
'Excited.'"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master, what shall we enjoy?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Status... 『 』... Aghhh!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It appears solving a riddle is required to 
open the door. Commencing unlocking 
mission.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle, rattle, rattle, rattle, rattle!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Master is surprisingly easily 
frightened, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If you are feeling anxious, please hold 
onto me. —Changing settings. Mode: 
'Escort.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Which attraction next? 
Cross-referencing—attractions not yet 
ridden are...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Mihono Bourbon is having 
fun. I breathe a sigh of relief.
choice_data_list: I'm glad you were able to enjoy yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ! Yes, current status: "having fun"...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Error encountered. Unable to search 
for... appropriate words...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Receiving a White Day return gift from 
Master makes me very happy. ...However... 
um... My words are not matching this 
happiness.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Even when I received the marshmallows... I 
felt like just saying 'thank you' wasn't 
enough... I've been searching for the 
right words this entire time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I put on this Valentine's outfit hoping to 
somehow convey my feelings... but it's not 
enough. Not nearly enough.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Master, what should I do... for these 
feelings to reach you?
choice_data_list:
Arranging words just as they come to 
mind...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her that if she puts her thoughts 
into words, she'll surely be able to 
convey her feelings.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I see... Order received. I'll give it a 
try.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master, thank you very much for the return 
gift. I am exceedingly pleased.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Severe error in language conversion 
program. Fixating on Master's expression 
causes candidate words to vanish one after 
another...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
None of these words... are enough. What 
I'm "feeling" goes so much deeper...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I let her know that I could sense her 
feelings of joy from her expression and 
demeanor.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Really...? Did it really come across?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
......Then please, tell me. I request that 
you translate the feelings I was trying to 
convey into words and state them clearly.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Checking the accuracy of transmission. 
Master, please proceed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, by offering various words of 
praise until Mihono Bourbon was satisfied, 
I realized just how immense her joy really 
was.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suggested that if she couldn't put it 
into words, she could try expressing it 
with gestures.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I'll try using... gestures.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon is performing a mysterious 
dance.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Transmission failed...!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I thought dance might convey my feelings, 
just like a Winning Live does, but...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
! Status: 'Inspiration'! Just like in a 
Winning Live, dancing together is 
predicted to increase mutual empathy.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A proposal. Master, let us dance!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though a bit embarrassed, I nod for her 
sake. Without either of us leading, we 
fall into step and dance together.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Master, did that reach you...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon's gaze, looking straight at 
me, wavered with a gentle warmth— making 
me feel as if I had touched her heart.
